settings.title: Access from a tablet
settings.hint: Browse and edit your campaigns from a tablet or phone on the same Wi-Fi as this PC. Each device must be authorized once, with a code shown here.
settings.enable: Allow access from the local network
settings.firewallNote: When you turn this on, Windows may ask to allow DM Loremind through the firewall: choose "Private networks" only. Only enable it on a trusted network (your home router), never on public Wi-Fi.
settings.addressTitle: Address to open on the tablet
settings.noAddress: No local network address found: check that this PC is connected to your Wi-Fi or home router.
settings.pairSteps: On the tablet, scan the QR code, or open the address above and enter this code:
settings.qrAlt: QR code to connect the tablet
settings.expiresIn: Valid for {{time}} more, for a single device
settings.codeError: Unable to create a pairing code.
settings.revokeMessage: "{{name}}" will no longer be able to access DM Loremind. A new code will be needed to reconnect it.
settings.revokeError: Unable to remove this device's access.
settings.outsideNote: To reach it away from home (on 4G, at a friend's), the documentation explains how to use Tailscale, a free encrypted private network. Don't open this port to the Internet on your router.
settings.onDevice: You are connected from a tablet: settings can only be changed on the PC where DM Loremind is installed.

pair.title: Connect this device
pair.text: On the PC, open Settings > Access from a tablet, then "Connect a device". Enter the 6-digit code shown there.
pair.nameHint: To recognize it in the list of authorized devices.
pair.rejected: Code rejected: check it, or show a new code on the PC.
pair.failed: Connection failed. Check that the PC is on and on the same network.
pair.onHostText: This page is for connecting a tablet. On this PC, access is managed from Settings.
